summary: Adds indexed notifications.conversation_id column (migration backfills) and marks notifications read by exact id instead of LIKE on JSON.

statements.why: Route still behind auth and authorize; query scoped to the user; no data loss.

statements.text: 1. Apply 2026_08_28_010101_add_conversation_id_column_to_notifications_table to your live database before the new code goes live (`php artisan migrate --force`), or the parts that use it will fail.
statements.why: Without the column, opening a conversation and creating notifications hit SQL errors.

misses.what: Card never says what changed: opening a conversation now marks its notifications read via the new indexed column and no longer wrongly marks those of conversations with the same leading digits (#12 vs #123).
The migration backfills every existing notification row in batches after a full LIKE scan; on large help desks it can take long, and the new code fails if live before it finishes.
